page.overview:
What is Dreamzzz?

First announced in May 2023 alongside the Dreamzzz series, the Dreamzzz theme follows Mateo and his friends protect the Dream World from various forces of evil as Dream Chasers.

The LEGO Dreamzzz Magazine was released on September 2023 alongside the main sets.

In 2024 as part of the collaboration between Fortnite and LEGO that resulted in LEGO Fortnite, two UEFN maps called Parkour Worlds and Chasers vs. Hunters were released
